label: public_informed_semantic_reconstruction_87
name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
provenance: public-informed warm-up candidate; semantic reconstruction using canonical updatedStates witness and commuting laws
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intros Hup Hinit
  have Hu := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  have Hi := InitStatesLength Hinit
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit Hi
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup) (InitStatesNodup Hinit), ?_⟩
  simp [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup, updatedStates]
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · apply updatedStatesUpdate Hu
    exact updatedStatesDefMonotone <| UpdateStatesDefined' Hup
  · rw [List.unzip_zip Hu, List.unzip_zip Hi]
    intro k hk hk'
    simpa [InitStatesNotDefined Hinit k hk'] using
      UpdateStatesDefined Hup k hk
